title: A simple approach to fabricate a highly-sensitive lead(II) ion electrochemical sensor based on plate-shaped Cu-BTC and particle-shaped Fe-BTC
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,1833-1847
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08888G, Paper
